title: nWo Japan splits into a leadership war
summary: Chono and Muto turn an invading faction into one of New Japan’s leading forces. Disagreement over its direction eventually produces a war between Muto’s nWo Japan and Chono’s Team 2000.

chapters.title: Muto commits to nWo Japan
chapters.result: Muto attacks Kensuke Sasaki and completes his alignment with the faction.
chapters.context: The distinction between Muto’s loyalist persona and the nWo-affiliated Great Muta collapses, giving Chono a major ally.

chapters.title: Muto reaches the heavyweight title
chapters.result: Muto defeats Scott Norton for the IWGP championship.
chapters.context: His leadership period reaches championship success, but Chono’s return soon creates a rival claim over the group’s identity.

chapters.title: Chono wins the faction showdown
chapters.context: Team 2000’s leader wins the major singles confrontation against his former partner, marking the end of nWo Japan’s separate chapter.
